reported.title: Blocking delay in blast() stalls heartbeat and button scan
reported.description: blast() uses delay(60), which blocks loop() so the 500 ms heartbeat can slip past its ±150 ms window and button scanning pauses during the blast, violating the timing spec.

reported.title: Horn pulse length not guaranteed / re-trigger during hold
reported.description: Because the horn is driven synchronously with delay, the 60 ms pulse is fine in isolation, but the blocking design means a press arriving during the blast is missed and the heartbeat drifts; the pulse should be non-blocking to keep D12 timing and serial cadence independent.

judge_input.spec:
- Horn relay on D12; dock button on D4 with internal pull-up (active LOW).
- A settled press on D4 sounds the horn: D12 HIGH for 60 ms, starting within 100 ms of the press.
- Contact bounce up to 10 ms on press and release must not sound the horn twice.
- A press that is still held after the horn stops does not sound it again.
- D12 stays LOW whenever no press has been accepted.
- Print `dock <n>` every 500 ms ±150 ms, with n counting the lines printed.
